title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: People & Culture Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95\+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.  

  

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**  

We are currently seeking a **People \& Culture Manager** to join our vibrant team.. At RHG , we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.


As a **People \& Culture Manager**, you infuse our HR team with a unique blend of strategic vision, a commitment to fostering a positive workplace culture, and an unwavering dedication to the personal and professional growth of our talented workforce.

* Ensures the smooth running of the Human Resources Department, where all areas of responsibility are managed and delivered to the highest levels.
* Works proactively to maximize the guest service and the team experience, delivering a positive and responsive approach to enquiries and problem resolution.
* Develops and implements plans where human resources initiatives \& hotel targets are achieved.
* Works with key stakeholders, effectively managing and reviewing the life cycle of the team within the hotel, fostering a culture of growth, development and performance.
* Owner of the Human Resources budget and training plan, where together with management, facilitates the evaluation of team performance.
* Builds and maintains effective working relationships with all key stakeholders and business partners.
* Reviews and scrutinizes employee resourcing, compensation, employee development, training and succession plans, providing recommendations that will enhance performance and provide added value to the individual and the company.
* Ensures adherence and compliance to all legislation where due diligence requirements and best practice activities are planned, delivered and documented for internal and external audit, performing follow\-up as required.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in HR with strong problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent leadership skills with a hands\-on approach and lead\-by\-example work style.
* Commitment to exceptional guest service with a passion for the hospitality industry.
* Ability to find creative solutions, offering advice and recommendations.
* Personal integrity, with the ability to work in an environment that demands excellence, time and energy.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?**

**Live the Magic of Hospitality \-** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career \-** No matter your background or experience, we invest in your **growth, learning, and career development**—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit \-** Join a workplace that’s **inclusive, fun, and meaningful**. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our **Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**.

**Lead with Your Ambition \-** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global \& Local Perks \-** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits \- like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Enjoy benefits such as** \- up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide  

Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends \& Family  

Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food \& Beverage, Spa and more

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**


We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

=====================================================


**Role Overview**
-----------------


As an HR Manager, you will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to performance management, payroll coordination, employee engagement, compliance, and exit formalities.  

This is a hands\-on role where you will work closely with management to build strong HR processes, foster a positive work culture, and support the company's growth by attracting, developing, and retaining the right talent.  

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in recruitment, HR operations, employee relations, and compliance within a fast\-paced organisation.

* Organise training sessions, team\-building activities, employee engagement programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and performance\-driven work culture while acting as the primary HR point of contact for employees.

### **HR Systems \& Administration**


* Maintain HRMS, employee databases, attendance systems, and HR reports.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS, recruitment reports, attrition reports, and manpower updates.
* Continuously improve HR processes and recommend initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

### **Experience**


* 3–6 years of experience in Human Resources with exposure to recruitment and HR operations.
* Experience in Real Estate, Consulting, BFSI, Startups, or Service Industries will be preferred.
* Experience handling end\-to\-end employee lifecycle management in a growing organisation is an added advantage.

### **Skills Required**


* Strong recruitment and interviewing skills.
* Sound knowledge of HR operations, payroll coordination, and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong organisational, multitasking, and problem\-solving skills.
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

### **Technical Skills**


* HRMS Platforms
* Payroll Software
* Microsoft Excel \& Google Workspace
* Employee Attendance \& Performance Management Systems

### **Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.

* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).

* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines

 **Organization Context**


Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products.  **Job Context:**

  

Translate regional gold loan strategy into area execution plan while balancing rapid growth with strict risk discipline. This position execution of business initiatives, overseeing profit and loss statements, ensuring adherence to risk management and regulatory compliance, and leading teams to meet established targets.

  

Key Challenges:

* Driving rapid AUM growth while maintaining strict LTV norms, low NPAs and strong collateral cover amid gold price volatility.
* Ensuring zero deviation compliance with RBO guidelines across a large, distributed branch network without slowing business momentum.
* Preventing fraud, jewelry substitution, internal collusion and security breaches while scaling operations

Skyspire Academy is an international education and exam\-preparation institute specializing in IELTS, CELPIP, TEF, TCF, DELF, PTE, and English proficiency programs. We are building a next\-generation learning platform that delivers structured lessons, mock exams, AI\-assisted evaluation, and student progress tracking across mobile and web.

We are looking for a high\-quality app builder who can transform a clear academic vision into a scalable, professional, and fully automated learning platform.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying a complete learning portal available on:

* Android
* iOS
* Web (browser\-based)

The platform will include student dashboards, exam simulations, AI\-assisted evaluations, admin controls, and automated workflows.

* Build a cross\-platform app (Android, iOS, Web) with consistent UX/UI
* Develop student, teacher, and admin dashboards
* Implement lesson modules, quizzes, mock tests, and progress tracking
* Integrate AI\-based writing \& speaking evaluation (API\-based)
* Enable audio/video uploads, recordings, and playback
* Design secure authentication, role\-based access, and data storage
* Automate workflows (test submission → evaluation → feedback → reports)

Required Skills \& Experience

* Proven experience building mobile \+ web apps (Flutter, React Native, Bubble, or similar)
* Strong backend knowledge (APIs, databases, authentication)
* Experience integrating AI tools / APIs (evaluation, transcription, scoring)
* Understanding of LMS or EdTech platforms is a strong advantage
* Experience with media handling (audio, video, PDFs)
* Ability to build clean, professional, education\-grade UI
* Strong problem\-solving and architectural thinking

Preferred (Nice to Have)

* Experience with payment gateways and subscriptions

* Clear academic vision and structured content
* Long\-term collaboration potential
* Flexible remote working
* Competitive project\-based compensation
* Opportunity to build a flagship international EdTech product

To be responsible for leading operations of our factory at Bagru Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Growth, legal compliances, capacity enhancement and maintenance.

1\.Manufacturing quality products as per schedule.


2\.Delivery of goods as per time scheduled by the customer.

* Good knowledge on packing machines of powder lines, liquid and viscous products.
* Good supervisory skills with capability of handling Company employees and contractors.
* Experience of retail, distribution and direct business product manufacturing exposure. Handling 300\+ finish goods SKUs and more than 1000 RM/PM exposure is desired.
* Problem solving and analytical abilities. Solution provider and positive attitude.
* Good English written and oral Communication. Good inter personnel skills and the ability to inspire and build a strong team.
* Good Coach and mentor.
* Integrity and honesty and able to foster it in team.
* Good production planning capability along with hands on experience with shift management. Handling Production activities, bringing improvements in Productivity and providing guidance to the manufacturing unit in production planning, Inventory Control, excellent managerial abilities.
* Resource organizing and networking capability.
* Hands on financial and factory cost understanding
* Hands on experience on SAP production module
* Basic knowledge of HR / IR requirements or experience

* Eye for operation excellence

 BE/BTech: Chemical or Mechanical. 10 to 14 years exp in Manufacturing.

description:
**INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH:**


Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation\-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.

**About Evernorth Health Services:**


Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group \- a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

**About Cigna:**


The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.


Cigna, a leading Health Services company, is looking for an exceptional Back end and API engineer in our Provider Engineering organization. This position is responsible for the delivery of a business need starting from understanding the requirements to deploying the software into production. This role requires you to be fluent in some of the critical technologies with proficiency in others, with a very strong analytical aptitude and have a hunger to learn on the job, understand data and add value to the business. Critical attributes of being a Back End Engineer, among others, is ownership, eagerness to learn \& an open mindset. In addition to delivery, the role demands having an automation first and continuous improvement mindset. The candidate should drive the adoption of CI/CD tools and support the improvement of the tools sets/processes. improvement of the tools sets/processes.

**Position Overview**


Are you looking for an opportunity to engineer modern application, Continuous Deployment/Continuous Integration, and embedded solutions(UI/API \& LLM) across a breadth of core platforms and technologies and foster a community while being supported with plentiful training and mentorship opportunities?


We’re looking for a Software Engineering Analyst who will be responsible to accelerate us on embedded solution(UI/API \& LLM) journey. The journey requires building foundational capabilities/patterns and enabling teams from a design, technical architecture and selecting LLM/cloud services wisely. This role requires proved technology excellence with strong hands\-on digital experience.


We are seeking a skilled and passionate Agentic AI Developer with 3–6 years of experience to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals who bring a fresh foundation in full stack development and have evolved into AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI domains. You will be instrumental in developing and deploying intelligent systems that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic architectures to solve complex business problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Gathers and analyzes test software requirements for various applications within the organization.
* Understands a program’s architecture/design, logical and physical data models.
* Design and Develop applications built in Python/C\#
* Good exposure on AI Concepts/Models (LLM)
* Support other product delivery partners in the successful build, test, and release of solutions
* Ability to work on projects independently with minimal or no oversight required.
* Examine and discover methods to improve the accuracy, effectiveness, and dependability of data quality and support.
* Support the full software lifecycle of design, development, testing, and support for technical delivery
* Works with both (Scrum Master, Product, QA and Developers) and QA team members in properly defining testable scenarios based on requirements/acceptance criteria.
* Be part of a fast\-moving team, working with the latest tools and open\-source technologies
* Work on a development team using agile methodologies.
* Understand the Business and the Application Architecture End to End
* Solve problems by crafting software solutions using maintainable and modular code
* Participate in daily team standup meetings where you'll give and receive updates on the current backlog and challenges.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science or Engineering or related course work
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in programming, API development and UI development. We need a very clear understanding \& be able to explain how would we develop sample cases.
* Basic hands on experience working in database environments like, Oracle, SQL, MongoDB etc
* Basic exposure in using IDE like Visual Studio Code, VS Code Etc
* Good hands on experience in Python, C\#. We need some passionate young developers to work on key initiatives which are aimed at accuracy \& efficiency.
* Design, fine\-tune, and deploy LLMs for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate LLMs with legacy systems and modern cloud\-native applications.
* Develop and optimize ML models for classification, prediction, and recommendation tasks.
* Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize models in production environments.
* Contribute to front\-end and back\-end development using Vue.js, Node.js, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Work with AWS services for scalable deployment of AI/ML solutions.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with advancements in GenAI, agentic frameworks, and cloud\-native AI tooling.

**Required Experience \& Education:**

* Proven hands on experience with design, and development of large\-scale enterprise application solutions.
* College degree (Bachelor) in related technical/business areas or equivalent work experience.
* Beginner level experience in relational and NOSQL databases
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in Software engineering
* Should be flexible in working with freshers and help them guide through the programme while they learn from senior resources in project.
* Hands on experience in developing applications in Python, C\# and machine learning concepts.
* Willing to learn, go above and beyond attitudes.
* Experience with modern and legacy development languages.

**Location \& Hours of Work**

* Full\-time position, working 40 hours per week. Expected overlap with US hours as appropriate
* Primarily based in the Innovation Hub in Hyderabad, India in a hybrid working model (3 days WFO and 2 days WAH)

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Front End Developer
description:
**About the Opportunity**

Frontend is not a support function at Gracia. It is central to how we design and ship products, and we are scaling that capability.

We are looking for a **UI/UX \& Frontend Developer – Figma, React, Flutter \& Full Stack** who can take a product idea, design it in Figma, and then build it into a production\-grade web or mobile application without hand\-holding at any stage. This is an end\-to\-end ownership role. You will design the interface, translate it into working code, integrate it with backend systems, and ship features that actually work, not just visually but functionally, for the business using them.

If you can design a clean, usable interface in Figma and then build it yourself in React and Flutter and want to grow inside a firm building real fintech products alongside its consulting practice, this role is for you.

**What You Will Do**

*UI/UX Design in Figma*  
Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI screens in Figma for web and mobile applications. Own the design process from concept to design system, layouts, components, spacing, states, and interactions, before a single line of code is written.

*Figma\-to\-Code Implementation*  
Convert your own (or existing) Figma UI designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive React (web) and Flutter (mobile) code. You own the full translation from design to functioning interface.

*Full Stack Web Application Development*  
Build and maintain web applications end\-to\-end, frontend components, API integration, state management, and where needed, backend/API work to support the features you're building.

*Cross\-Platform Mobile Development*  
Develop and maintain Flutter applications for iOS and Android from a single codebase, ensuring consistent behaviour and performance across platforms.

*Design System \& Component Architecture*  
Build and maintain a reusable design system in Figma, and mirror it in code through reusable, maintainable component libraries, so new screens and features can be designed and built faster without duplicating work.

*API Integration \& Data Flow*  
Integrate frontend applications with REST/GraphQL APIs, third\-party services, and internal systems (including Zoho and FinBowl/PEMS). Understand how data moves through the application, not just how to display it.

*Performance \& Quality*  
Optimise for load time, responsiveness, and smooth interactions. Write code that is testable, debuggable, and doesn't break under real\-world use.

*Collaboration with Product \& Stakeholders*  
Work closely with product owners and, where relevant, clients, to understand what's needed, design it, validate it, and then build it, closing the loop yourself instead of handing off between design and dev.

*Deployment \& Handover*  
Ship features to production, document your work, and ensure both the Figma files and codebase remain understandable and maintainable for whoever touches them next.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong working knowledge of **Figma** — wireframing, prototyping, component\-based design systems, and handoff\-ready files.
* Strong working knowledge of **React** (hooks, state management, component design) and **Flutter/Dart** for cross\-platform mobile development.
* Proven ability to take a product requirement, design it in Figma, and then build it into responsive, accurate frontend code, end to end, without significant rework.
* Full stack comfort — you can work with APIs, basic backend logic, and databases, even if your primary strength is frontend and design.
* Understanding of **REST/GraphQL APIs**, authentication flows, and state management patterns (Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, Provider, or similar).
* Strong eye for **UI/UX fundamentals** — visual hierarchy, spacing, usability, and consistent interaction patterns.
* Automation and tooling mindset — comfortable with Git, CI/CD basics, and writing code that scales beyond a single feature.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll work directly with product owners, and occasionally clients.
* Experience with mobile app store deployment (Play Store/App Store) is a plus.
* Prior experience designing and building fintech, CRM, or ERP\-adjacent applications is a strong advantage.

**Who Should Apply**

Candidates with **1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience** in UI/UX design (Figma) combined with React and Flutter development. Freshers with an exceptional portfolio (Figma designs paired with shipped code) and strong communication skills will also be considered. Must be based in Mumbai or willing to relocate.

**Location:** Mumbai, India

Step into the role of FCS People Leader \- Adverse Media Screening at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
 

You will focus on leading a team that delivers high quality financial crime screening activities, ensuring effective identification and management of adverse media risks. The role combines strong people leadership with operational oversight to maintain regulatory compliance, drive team performance, and support informed risk\-based decisions within Barclays.
  

  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:


* Lead and coach a team responsible for adverse media screening, ensuring high standards of quality, productivity, and regulatory compliance.
* Oversee the review and assessment of adverse media alerts, transaction monitoring outcomes, and KYC screening activities to support effective financial crime risk management.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve complex cases, provide risk guidance, and ensure timely escalation of high\-risk findings.
* Monitor team performance through quality reviews, performance metrics, and continuous coaching while fostering a culture of accountability and development.
* Drive operational excellence by implementing process improvements, strengthening controls, and ensuring adherence to AML, KYC, and financial crime policies.

Desirable skills set:


* Strong experience in Adverse Media Screening, Transaction Monitoring, KYC, AML, and Financial Crime Compliance.
* Proven leadership, experience with the ability to coach, mentor, and develop high\-performing operational teams.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making capabilities, with the ability to assess complex risk scenarios and make sound, risk\-based judgements.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication skills with the confidence to engage across business, compliance, and risk functions.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based out of Gurugram.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders (including business leaders, project manager and SMEs) and external stakeholders (including vendors and service providers) to support business operations and promote alignment with the bank's objectives and SLAs.
* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: HR Manager
description:
Looking for an experienced HR Generalist – Manager to lead end\-to\-end HR operations with a strong emphasis on payroll processing, statutory compliance, and HRIS management. This role is ideal for a hands\-on HR professional who combines generalist breadth (employee lifecycle, policy, employee relations) with deep expertise in payroll accuracy, labour law compliance, and HR systems — particularly GreytHR.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Management:

* Own end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for all employees, ensuring 100% accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage payroll inputs — new joiners, exits, salary revisions, attendance, leave, reimbursements, loans/advances, one time payments, and full \& final settlements.
* Reconcile payroll data with finance/accounts before disbursement; coordinate bank file uploads and salary disbursal.
* Generate and distribute payslips, Form 16, and other payroll\-related documents.
* Handle payroll\-related employee queries and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance:

* Ensure full compliance with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, Gratuity, and Bonus Act requirements.
* Manage timely statutory filings, challans, and returns (PF/ESI/PT monthly \& annual returns).
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable state/central regulations; assess and implement impact on policies and payroll. Liaise with auditors, statutory bodies, and consultants for audits, inspections, and assessments.
* Maintain compliance trackers/dashboards and ensure zero\-default status across all statutory obligations.
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping for compliance audits (internal and external).

HRIS / GreytHR Management:

* Serve as the primary system owner/admin for GreytHR (or equivalent HRMS) — data accuracy and process flow.
* Manage employee master data, attendance, leave, and payroll modules within the system.
* Generate HR MIS reports, payroll reports, and compliance reports from GreytHR for management review.
* Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with the vendor for upgrades, integrations, or fixes.
* Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual intervention in payroll and compliance workflows.

HR Generalist Responsibilities:

* Manage the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmation, transfers, exits, and full \& final settlement.
* Draft, update, and implement HR policies in line with statutory and organizational requirements.
* Support employee relations — grievance handling, disciplinary processes, and policy clarifications.
* Coordinate performance management cycles, including data tracking and reporting.
* Partner with Finance on cost\-to\-company (CTC) structuring, budgeting, and payroll cost analysis.
* Support internal/external HR audits and ensure documentation readiness at all times.

Experience: 3–5 years in HR Generalist roles, with at least 1–2 years focused on payroll and statutory compliance.

**Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of GreytHR (payroll, attendance, leave, and reporting modules) — mandatory.** 

**◦ Proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, payroll reconciliation). ◦ Familiarity with other HRMS/payroll tools is a plus.** 

Compliance Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus Act, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other applicable labour laws.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using GreytHR?

Work Location: In person

**Job Description – Assistant Manager / Manager – ESG, Sustainability \& ComplianceESG \| Sustainability \| EHS \| Compliance \| ISO \| Circular Economy**

**Company:** JC Global  
**Location:** **Gummidipoondi, Chennai**  
**Reporting To:** COO / Plant Head / CHRO (as applicable)

About JC Global

JC Global is a leading circular economy company engaged in manufacturing high\-quality recycled polymer granules and Polymer Pyrolysis Oil (PPO) from post\-consumer and post\-industrial plastic waste. We are committed to sustainable manufacturing, environmental stewardship, ESG excellence, and global compliance standards.

We are looking for a dynamic ESG \& Sustainability professional to drive environmental, social, governance, and statutory compliance initiatives across our manufacturing operations.

Position Summary

The Assistant Manager / Manager – ESG, Sustainability \& Compliance will be responsible for implementing and monitoring the company's ESG framework, sustainability initiatives, EHS compliance, statutory documentation, certifications, customer sustainability requirements, audit preparedness, and reporting. The role will work closely with Production, EHS, HR, Quality, Maintenance, Procurement, and Corporate teams to ensure compliance with Indian regulations and global customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities1\. ESG Strategy \& Implementation

* Implement and monitor the company's ESG roadmap.
* Drive environmental, social, and governance initiatives across all manufacturing units.
* Develop ESG KPIs and sustainability dashboards.
* Monitor ESG targets and prepare periodic management reports.
* Coordinate ESG committee meetings and maintain action trackers.

2\. Sustainability Programs

* Lead sustainability projects focused on circular economy, waste reduction, energy efficiency, water conservation, and carbon footprint reduction.
* Identify and implement resource conservation initiatives.
* Monitor waste generation, recycling efficiency, and material recovery.
* Support Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) and sustainability improvement initiatives.

3\. ESG Reporting \& Customer Requirements

* Prepare ESG reports for customers, investors, and management.
* Coordinate sustainability questionnaires from global customers.
* Maintain sustainability performance data and evidence.
* Support preparation of annual sustainability reports.
* Coordinate CDP, EcoVadis, SEDEX, and customer sustainability assessments where applicable.

4\. Environmental Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Pollution Control Board requirements.
* Coordinate Consent to Establish (CTE) and Consent to Operate (CTO) renewals.
* Monitor hazardous waste, plastic waste, EPR, and environmental records.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring reports.
* Maintain legal environmental registers.

5\. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

* Manage EPR documentation and compliance.
* Coordinate EPR portal submissions and reconciliations.
* Maintain traceability of plastic waste procurement and recycling.
* Coordinate with recyclers, producers, and compliance agencies.

6\. Certifications \& Management Systems

Lead and maintain certification requirements for:

* ISO 9001
* ISO 14001
* ISO 45001
* IMS
* ISCC PLUS
* GRS (Global Recycled Standard)
* RecyClass (preferred)
* Zero Waste to Landfill initiatives
* Carbon accounting frameworks

Coordinate certification audits, surveillance audits, and corrective actions.

7\. Audit Management

* Prepare for customer, certification, regulatory, and investor audits.
* Maintain audit documentation and evidence.
* Track audit observations and corrective actions.
* Ensure timely closure of non\-conformities (NCs).

8\. Compliance Management

* Maintain legal compliance registers.
* Track statutory approvals, licences, and renewals.
* Coordinate with consultants and government authorities.
* Monitor compliance obligations under applicable environmental and labour regulations.

9\. EHS Coordination

* Support implementation of Environment, Health \& Safety systems.
* Conduct workplace inspections and compliance reviews.
* Coordinate risk assessments and corrective actions.
* Promote behavioural safety and environmental awareness.
* Coordinate emergency preparedness and mock drills.

10\. Carbon \& Climate Initiatives

* Collect and analyse energy, fuel, water, and emission data.
* Support greenhouse gas (GHG) inventory preparation.
* Monitor carbon footprint reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for renewable energy and energy efficiency.
* Support carbon credit and decarbonization initiatives.

11\. ESG Documentation \& Data Management

* Maintain ESG dashboards and sustainability databases.
* Develop SOPs, policies, manuals, and work instructions.
* Maintain digital document management systems.
* Ensure accurate document version control and audit readiness.

12\. Training \& Awareness

* Conduct ESG, sustainability, EHS, and compliance training.
* Develop awareness campaigns and toolbox sessions.
* Promote sustainability culture throughout the organization.
* Maintain employee training records.

13\. Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with Production, HR, Quality, Procurement, Maintenance, and Finance teams.
* Liaise with certification bodies, consultants, auditors, customers, and government agencies.
* Support CSR and community sustainability initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* ESG compliance score.
* Audit success rate.
* Closure of non\-conformities within target timelines.
* Certification maintenance without major observations.
* Legal compliance adherence.
* EPR reporting accuracy and timeliness.
* Carbon and energy reduction initiatives implemented.
* Water conservation achievements.
* Waste recycling efficiency.
* Training completion rate.
* Customer sustainability assessment scores.
* ESG dashboard accuracy and reporting timelines.

Desired Candidate ProfileEducation

* BE/B.Tech (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or related discipline) **or**
* MBA / PG Diploma in Sustainability, ESG, Environment, or Industrial Safety.

Experience

* **5–10 years** of experience in ESG, sustainability, EHS, compliance, or management systems within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in plastics, polymers, recycling, chemicals, process industries, or engineering manufacturing is preferred.

Technical Knowledge

* ESG reporting frameworks.
* Circular economy and sustainability principles.
* Environmental legislation and statutory compliance.
* Pollution Control Board regulations.
* Plastic Waste Management Rules and EPR.
* ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, IMS.
* ISCC PLUS, GRS, RecyClass (preferred).
* Carbon accounting and GHG reporting.
* Internal auditing and CAPA.
* Microsoft Excel, Power BI (preferred), and ERP/Document Management Systems.

Core Competencies

About JC Global

JC Global is a rapidly growing circular economy manufacturing company engaged in the production of recycled polymer granules and sustainable recycling solutions. We are committed to operational excellence, digital HR transformation, employee engagement, and world\-class manufacturing practices.

We are looking for a disciplined, proactive, and system\-oriented **HR \& Administration Officer** to support the HR Manager in managing daily plant HR operations, administration, workforce coordination, compliance, employee engagement, and digital HRMS processes.

Position Summary

The HR \& Administration Officer will serve as the backbone of plant HR operations, ensuring smooth workforce management, accurate attendance, shift planning, compliance documentation, HRMS data integrity, employee welfare, administration, and coordination across departments. The role requires close collaboration with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Stores, EHS, Security, and Contractors to maintain an efficient, compliant, and well\-organized manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Time Office \& Attendance Management

* Manage manual attendance for workers, staff, and contract labour.
* Verify biometric attendance with Zoho People HRMS.
* Resolve attendance discrepancies with department heads.
* Maintain attendance, overtime, absenteeism, and shift\-wise manpower reports.
* Ensure daily attendance accuracy and payroll readiness.

2\. Shift Planning \& Workforce Coordination

* Prepare and maintain shift rosters and duty schedules.
* Coordinate manpower deployment across shifts.
* Manage weekly offs, leave replacements, and shift changes.
* Ensure adequate staffing for uninterrupted plant operations.

3\. HR Operations Support

* Coordinate onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits through HRMS.
* Guide employees and HR officers on HRMS workflows.
* Support appointment letters, employee documentation, and HR records.
* Conduct induction and orientation for new employees.
* Track probation and confirmation processes.

4\. Leave \& Employee Movement

* Maintain leave registers and on\-duty permission records.
* Monitor leave balances and attendance regularization.
* Coordinate employee movement approvals.

5\. Administration \& Facility Management

* Ensure office, HR department, meeting rooms, and common areas are neat, clean, and organized.
* Monitor the working condition of printers, computers, internet, CCTV, biometric systems, telephones, and office equipment.
* Coordinate repairs, maintenance, and vendor support.
* Maintain office supplies and stationery inventory.

6\. Visitor Management

* Maintain visitor entry and exit records.
* Coordinate visitor passes and safety induction.
* Ensure visitor PPE compliance.

7\. Employee Asset \& Welfare Management

* Coordinate issuance and return of:

* Uniforms
* PPE and safety gear
* Mobile phones and SIM cards
* Laptops/desktops
* Access cards
* Maintain complete asset issuance records.
* Manage lunch coupon issuance and reconciliation.
* Organize employee welfare initiatives and engagement activities.
* Coordinate annual medical check\-up camps.

8\. Recruitment \& Employee Lifecycle Support

* Assist with recruitment coordination and interview scheduling.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews.
* Maintain recruitment status and candidate trackers.
* Support onboarding and exit formalities.
* Coordinate relieving letters, experience certificates, and exit interviews.

9\. Training \& Learning Coordination

title: Engineering Manager - Marketplace
description:
Role Description:

As Engineering Manager, you will manage a cross\-functional team of engineers implementing the content strategy for Booking.com, leading the transition of these foundations into an AI\-native model where copy agents generate copy and translations at design and code time, QA runs continuously, and changes ship and are tested across markets at once, cutting time\-to\-market and cost. You will own the guardrails that keep this trustworthy, including governance and compliance, accuracy, brand consistency, and robust evaluation of agent output. Success depends on aligning a complex set of stakeholders, from UX writers, designers, product, and engineering to localization, experimentation, legal, and senior leadership.

 **Key Job Responsibilities and Duties**


As a **Software Engineering Manager** you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.


Important aspects of the job include:

* Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth.  

Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.
* Ensure delivery through ownership by being proactive, collaborating with peers and stakeholders, tracking roadmap progress, and resolving or escalating blockers.
* Manage team stakeholders by clearly and regularly reporting progress and blockers to ensure transparency and alignment.  

Support recruitment and planning by participating in headcount planning and involving your team in hiring processes.
* Coach and mentor colleagues across levels by sharing your experience, knowledge, and approaches to work to improve overall performance.
* Own systems end to end by monitoring application health and performance, setting and responding to relevant metrics, and guiding junior team members in these practices.  

Reduce operational risk by applying state\-of\-the\-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.
* Improve system reliability by addressing live production issues within SLA, contributing to root cause analysis, and logging and learning from incidents via postmortems.
* Build high\-quality software by applying relevant development languages, using standard libraries and design patterns, and following testing strategies that ensure security, integrity, and quality.
* Guide architectural decisions by advising on technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements, and aligning improvements with the wider architectural landscape.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing improvements in processes, systems, and structures, and by applying critical thinking to evaluate and develop ideas.

 **Role Qualifications and Requirements**

**Must\-Haves:**

* 8\+ years of experience in building enterprise software products. Previous experience as a developer will be preferred
* 1\+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager (must be a dedicated management role, not a temporary caretaking assignment).
* Ability to read and understand code and apply simple design patterns to refactor code and ensure quality standard by applying testing strategies
* Maintain data security, integrity and quality by following company standards, best practices and relevant legislation.
* Ability to evaluate possible architecture solutions by taking into account the cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies.
* Ability to describe the implications for changing an existing system or adding a new system to a specific area, by having a broad, high\-level understanding of the infrastructure and architecture of our systems.
* Ability to help grow the business and/or accelerate software development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor evaluation) and Bookings technical standards.

description:
About HireRight:

We empower organizations around the world to hire with precision and act with confidence. As a global leader in background screening and workforce intelligence, we combine smart technology, human expertise, and a passion for delivering speed and accuracy to create a seamless experience for both employers and candidates. Headquartered in Nashville, TN, and operating in over 200 countries and territories, we’re proud to help millions of people get hired — the right way.


Overview:

We are seeking a high‑impact Senior HR Business Partner who is not only a strategic thought partner but also exceptionally strong with numbers, analytics, and business insights. This individual will play a critical role in shaping people strategy in India, driving organizational transformation, and enabling business performance across global teams.

  

The ideal candidate is business‑savvy, highly analytical, action‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, and skilled at navigating complex stakeholder relationships while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

* **Strategic \& Analytical Impact:** HR strategies informed by deep data insights and business metrics, resulting in measurable improvements in productivity, talent health, and organizational performance.
* **Leadership Influence:** Strong advisory capabilities with senior leaders, backed by clear data storytelling and evidence‑based recommendations.
* **Change Leadership:** Successful execution of organizational change initiatives with agility, clarity, and stakeholder alignment.
* **Operational Excellence:** High‑quality delivery of global HR programs with local relevance – on time, with discipline, and with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* **Employee Experience:** Strengthened engagement and improved retention through proactive interventions grounded in data and business acumen.

* **Ownership \& Accountability:** Critical for the role
* **Employee Relations \& Employment Law Acumen:** Demonstrates strong working knowledge of local labour laws and applies it to manage complex ER matters
* **Business Acumen \& Financial Understanding** – Connects business metrics (revenue, productivity, cost drivers) with people strategies; translates data into actionable decisions.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making** – Strong ability to analyze workforce data, identify trends, diagnose issues, and propose data‑backed recommendations.
* **Influencing \& Stakeholder Management** – Builds trust, manages senior stakeholders effectively, and drives alignment across global teams.
* **Change Leadership** – Leads transformation initiatives with clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes.
* **Execution \& Action Orientation** – Moves quickly from insight to action, makes informed decisions, and manages multiple projects with precision.
* **Cultural Intelligence** – Navigates global and local cultural nuances to design inclusive and impactful HR solutions.
* **Prioritization \& Multitasking** – Manages high volumes of work and parallel projects without compromising quality.

  


Qualifications: **Experience \& Knowledge**

* Proven experience as an Senior HR Business Partner in a global matrix environment.
* Hands‑on experience in talent management, workforce planning, organizational design, performance management, and change management.

	+ Effective local deployment of global HR initiatives with minimal rework and strong stakeholder alignment.
	+ Timely delivery and quality of multiple HR projects and priorities.
	+ Demonstrated ability to make fast, informed decisions with clear rationale.

* + 5\+ years of progressive HR experience in a global or matrixed HRBP role.
	+ Strong numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret and act on data.
	+ Proven capability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
	+ Experience in organizational design, talent management, and leading change.
	+ Excellent communication skills, including data‑backed storytelling.
	+ Ability to operate in a fast‑moving, deadline‑driven environment while managing multiple priorities.
	+ High degree of ownership, decision‑making ability, and action orientation.


What do we offer:

Please submit resume/CV in English.  

All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.  

  

HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

description:

We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable **IT Recruitment Trainer** to develop and deliver training programs that equip aspiring recruiters with the skills needed to effectively identify, evaluate, and hire top IT talent. **Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and deliver comprehensive training modules on **IT recruitment** covering both technical and soft skills.
* Train learners on full\-cycle recruitment including job analysis, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Educate participants on different **IT roles**, technologies, programming languages, and tools to enhance technical understanding.
* Demonstrate effective use of **job portals, ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems), Boolean search**, LinkedIn sourcing, and other recruitment tools.
* Conduct mock interviews, role\-plays, and real\-time simulations to improve learner confidence and proficiency.
* Evaluate trainee performance and provide constructive feedback and improvement plans.
* Stay updated with the latest trends in **IT hiring, tech stacks, and recruitment methodologies**.
* Customize training sessions to meet the skill levels of beginners, intermediates, and experienced professionals.
* Prepare and maintain training reports, assessments, and documentation.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, IT, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in **IT recruitment** or **technical hiring**, preferably in an agency or corporate setting.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

* High energy, patience, and passion for teaching and people development.

title: HR - People Operations
description:
#### **About the Team**



Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.


#### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced Manager – HR Operations \& HR Systems to lead and manage HR operations while ensuring the smooth functioning of HR systems. This role involves overseeing the day\-to\-day HR processes, ensuring data accuracy and integrity within HR systems, and implementing process improvements. The successful candidate will act as a key liaison between HR, IT, and other departments to support HR digitalization, optimize operational efficiencies, and drive impactful HR initiatives.



### **What you will do**


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Management**


* Own and lead end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee movements, confirmations, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, benefits administration, leave \& attendance, separations, and offboarding.
* Ensure seamless, consistent, and high\-quality employee experiences across all people processes.
* Establish and continuously improve standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver operational excellence.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Legal, and Business Leaders to ensure efficient delivery of People Operations.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment documentation, contracts, letters, statutory records, and employee records.

### **2\. People Operations Governance**


* Drive operational governance by establishing service standards, SLAs, quality controls, and compliance mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, labor laws, statutory regulations, and audit requirements across all HR operations.
* Own policy implementation and operational compliance while ensuring process consistency across the organization.
* Lead internal and external audits related to employee records, HR operations, and statutory compliance.

### **3\. HR Systems \& Digital Operations**


* Own the operational effectiveness of the organization's HR technology ecosystem, including HRMS, Payroll, Attendance, Performance Management, Learning, Survey, and other People systems.
* Partner with HR Systems and IT teams to support system implementations, enhancements, testing, integrations, and process optimization.
* Drive system adoption, data accuracy, and continuous improvements across HR platforms.
* Leverage technology to simplify employee transactions and improve operational efficiency.

### **4\. Process Excellence \& Automation**


* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify, standardize, and automate People Operations processes.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and employee experience.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives by reducing manual interventions and increasing self\-service capabilities.
* Establish operational metrics and continuously improve turnaround times and service quality.

### **5\. HR Analytics \& Operational Insights**


* Own People Operations dashboards and reporting across employee lifecycle metrics, workforce movements, service delivery, compliance, and operational performance.
* Generate actionable insights to support workforce planning and strategic decision\-making.
* Monitor operational KPIs, identify trends, and recommend process improvements.
* Present periodic operational reviews and governance updates to HR and business leadership.

### **6\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Build strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Information Security, Legal, and external vendors to ensure seamless delivery of People Operations.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex employee lifecycle and operational issues.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes and continuously improve service delivery.

### **7\. Team Leadership**


* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing People Operations team.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer\-centricity, and operational excellence.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing, and process documentation.
### **What you will need**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA in HR is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in HR Operations or People Operations, with proven experience managing end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience leading People Operations teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth organizations.
* Exposure to HR technology platforms and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders in matrix organizations.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end employee lifecycle management.
* Expertise in HR operations, HR shared services, payroll coordination, benefits administration, employee documentation, and compliance.
* Sound knowledge of labor laws, statutory compliance, and HR governance.
* Strong understanding of HR systems and technology\-enabled service delivery.
* Operational Excellence and Process Optimization
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* HR Technology \& Digital Transformation
* Service Delivery \& Shared Services Management
* HR Analytics and Reporting
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
* Team Leadership and People Management
* Change Management
* Project \& Program Management
* Process Automation \& Continuous Improvement
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Excellent communication and stakeholder influencing skills

### **Preferred Certifications**


* SHRM\-CP/SHRM\-SCP, PHR/SPHR, or equivalent HR certification.
* Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement certification.
* Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile, or equivalent).
* Certifications in HR technology platforms are an added advantage.

This role will be based out of Pune/Noida.


**Purpose of the role**


To develop, implement and maintain compensation programmes and provide advice to resolve any related issues.


**Accountabilities**


* Development (including design and related analysis), implementation and delivery of compensation programmes aligned to the organisation’s strategy and applicable regulations, including the provision of advice throughout the employee lifecycle and during the annual pay review, advising on related services and the resolution of reward and compensation issues from employees, people leaders, or regulators.

**Vice President Expectations**


* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
