title: Associate Project Engineer – LGSF
description:
**Why this role exists**


This role exists to build early\-career talent in Light Gauge Steel Framing, BIM/VDC, prefabrication, and construction technology workflows. The role is designed for freshers who are eager to learn how digital models, drawings, coordination processes, and fabrication\-ready deliverables support real construction projects.


When this role is performed well, freshers develop strong technical foundations, contribute to accurate project deliverables, support senior team members effectively, and gradually grow into independent project contributors. This role helps create a pipeline of skilled engineers who can support scalable, quality\-driven delivery across LGSF and prefab\-focused projects.

**What You Will Learn and Support**

**Project Delivery and Modeling Support**

* Support the development of accurate 3D models for Light Gauge Steel Framing using Revit, MWF/Tekla, or similar tools.
* Assist in preparing model views, shop drawings, basic schedules, and project documentation under guidance from team members.
* Learn to read architectural, structural, and engineering drawings to understand project scope and modeling requirements.
* Support project setup activities such as file organization, view creation, model cleanup, and documentation control.
* Assist in updating models and drawings based on comments, markups, RFIs, and coordination inputs.

**Coordination and Communication**

* Participate in internal coordination discussions to understand project priorities, design intent, and delivery expectations.
* Coordinate with team members to resolve basic modeling or documentation issues.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly to project leads/coaches.
* Learn how BIM/VDC models support downstream teams such as fabrication, procurement, and field execution.
* Develop confidence in professional communication through project reviews and team interactions.

**Process Learning and Technical Growth**

* Learn standard BIM workflows, naming conventions, modeling standards, and quality requirements.
* Follow established SOPs, templates, and checklists to maintain consistency in deliverables.
* Explore tools such as Revit, Navisworks, ACC/Forma, Bluebeam, MWF, Tekla, Vertex BD, Dynamo, or similar platforms.
* Support basic quality checks by reviewing model accuracy, drawing completeness, and adherence to project standards.
* Build awareness of automation, data\-driven workflows, and emerging construction technologies.

**Team Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work closely with engineers and project teams to complete assigned tasks on time.
* Be open to feedback and actively improve modeling, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Maintain accountability for assigned work and ask questions early when information is unclear.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing learnings and supporting peers.
* Demonstrate curiosity, discipline, and a willingness to learn new tools and construction workflows.

**A day in this role**


The day starts by reviewing assigned tasks, project priorities, and guidance from senior team members. You work on model development, drawing updates, documentation tasks, or markups while checking project standards and references. You coordinate with teammates to clarify requirements and resolve basic issues. Time is spent learning software tools, understanding LGSF systems, reviewing drawing sets, and incorporating feedback into deliverables. As you grow, you begin supporting quality checks, coordination preparation, and workflow improvements. The day closes with progress updates, documenting open questions, and preparing the next set of project tasks.

**What You Should Bring**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field.
* Fresher, or 0–1 year of experience, or strong academic/project exposure in BIM, Revit modeling, construction drawings, or prefabrication workflows.
* Basic understanding of construction drawings, building elements, and engineering documentation.
* Interest in Light Gauge Steel Framing, prefabrication, BIM/VDC, modular construction, or construction technology.
* Basic knowledge of tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, ACC/BIM 360, Bluebeam, or similar platforms.
* Willingness to learn LGSF\-related tools such as MWF, Tekla, Vertex BD, FrameCAD, or similar software.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
* Attention to detail, learning mindset, and ability to follow standards and instructions.
* Interest in process improvement, automation, and emerging construction technologies.

**What Will Make Your Application Stand Out**

* Academic or internship experience in BIM modeling, CAD\-to\-BIM, Scan\-to\-BIM, construction documentation, or structural/architectural modeling.
* Exposure to Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, ACC/BIM 360, Bluebeam, Dynamo, or other BIM\-related tools.
* Basic understanding of Light Gauge Steel Framing, cold\-formed steel, prefabrication, modular construction, or DfMA concepts.
* Ability to read drawings, follow markups, and produce clean, accurate models or drawing outputs.
* Demonstrated curiosity through certifications, personal projects, training programs, or portfolio work related to BIM/VDC.
* Strong ownership mindset, willingness to learn from feedback, and interest in building a long\-term career in construction technology.

**About vConstruct:** vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different set of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.

**DPR Construction** is a commercial general contractor and construction manager in USA specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things—great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com.

**Job Title**: Customer Support

**Location**: Madurai

**Job Title:** Customer Support Executive

**Employment Type**: Full\-time

**Preferred: A**ny Candidate

**Salary:** Rs.8000 \- Rs.15000

**Qualification**: Any Degree \- Fresher \- 2 yrs Experience

**Job Description**

We are looking for a **Customer Support Executive** to support our customers in using our jewellery business software smoothly for their daily operations. The candidate will handle customer queries, provide basic product guidance, coordinate with the technical team, and ensure timely issue resolution.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Handle customer calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, and support tickets.
* Understand customer queries and provide clear solutions.
* Guide customers on software usage, billing, sales, purchase, inventory, reports, and basic accounts.
* Provide basic training and support to customers.
* Record customer issues clearly in the support system.
* Coordinate with the development and QA teams for bug fixes or technical issues.
* Follow up with customers until the issue is resolved.
* Maintain daily support updates and ticket status.
* Identify repeated issues and share feedback for product improvement.
* Maintain polite and professional communication with customers.

Required Skills

* Good communication skills in Tamil and basic English.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Ability to understand software screens and explain them to customers.
* Patience in handling customer queries.
* Problem\-solving attitude.
* Willingness to learn jewellery business workflows.
* Basic billing, inventory, or accounting knowledge is an added advantage.

Qualification

Any degree / diploma can apply.  
Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.

Experience

0–2 years of experience in customer support, software support, billing support, or retail support is preferred.

Work Nature

* Office\-based customer support.
* Customer coordination through phone, WhatsApp, email, and support ticket system.
* Product training and issue follow\-up.
* Shift\-based work may be required based on support needs.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Electronics Engineer (Freshers \& 1–2 Years Experience)**

**Location:** Jalandhar, Punjab (Work from Office)  
**Experience:** Freshers / 1–2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for passionate Electronics Engineers who enjoy working with embedded systems and product development. Whether you're a recent graduate eager to learn or have up to 2 years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work on real\-world IoT and embedded projects.

Responsibilities

* Develop firmware for embedded systems and microcontrollers.
* Assist in hardware design, testing, and debugging.
* Read and understand electronic schematics.
* Support PCB design, bring\-up, and validation.
* Interface sensors, communication modules, and peripherals.
* Debug firmware and hardware\-related issues.
* Collaborate with the software and hardware teams throughout product development.

Requirements

* B.Tech/B.E./Diploma in Electronics, Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Electrical \& Electronics (EEE), Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of embedded C/C\+\+.
* Understanding of microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, Arduino, AVR, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with electronic components and digital/analog circuits.
* Basic understanding of PCB design concepts and hardware debugging.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, BLE, or MQTT is a plus.
* Eagerness to learn and solve technical challenges.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with ESP\-IDF, STM32CubeIDE, or Arduino IDE.
* Exposure to PCB design tools such as KiCad or EasyEDA.
* Hands\-on experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, or soldering equipment.
* Personal embedded or IoT projects are highly appreciated.

What You'll Get

* Work on real client products and IoT solutions.
* Mentorship from experienced embedded engineers.
* Exposure to firmware, hardware, PCB design, cloud integration, and product development.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to grow your technical skills.

If you're passionate about electronics, firmware development, and building innovative products, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Required Years Of Experience – 2\-5 Years Of Relevant Experience**
 We are seeking a motivated and adaptable individual to join our Security Fleet Operations team. The ideal candidate is a quick learner with strong technical aptitude and a proactive mindset. This role involves supporting fleet security processes, monitoring systems, implementation of security rules, and ensuring compliance with organizational security standards.
   

  

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**
 At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and monitor security fleet operations across multiple environments.
* Learn and apply security protocols for fleet management, including incident response and risk mitigation.
* Perform log analysis and end\-to\-end packet flow reviews to identify anomalies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure operational efficiency and compliance.
* Support documentation and reporting on security activities and fleet performance.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives for security processes.


**Required Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong Learning Ability: Demonstrated capacity to quickly grasp new concepts, tools, and technologies.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to assess situations, identify risks, and propose solutions.
* Attention to Detail: Ensure accuracy in monitoring and reporting.
* Communication Skills: Clear and professional interaction with team members and stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in dynamic environments and learning on the go.


**Additional Technical Skills**
* Ability to read and interpret logs and perform end\-to\-end packet flow analysis.
* Understanding of network security device functions such as:
+ Firewall
+ Proxy
+ Web Application Firewall (WAF)
+ Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)
+ Intrusion Detection System (IDS)
+ Cloud Security concepts and controls

* Proficiency in tools such as:
+ Wireshark (packet capture and analysis)
+ GitLab (version control and automation)
+ PowerShell (scripting and automation)
+ SIEM tools (security event monitoring and analysis)

* Exposure to:
+ Managing and monitoring CrowdStrike for endpoint detection and response (EDR)
+ Administering Tanium for endpoint management and compliance
+ Certificate Management
+ DLP (Data Loss Prevention) solutions


**Soft Skills (Highly Important)**
* Quick Learner \& Adaptability: Ability to rapidly understand new technologies and processes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Work effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Problem\-Solving Mindset: Proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing solutions.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Leadership \& Ownership: Take initiative and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of security principles or fleet operations.
* Familiarity with IT systems or security tools is a plus.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


**How We Support Our Colleagues**
 In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. title: Information Security Analyst
description:
**Eurofins Scientific** 
 is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
   

  





 The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.
   

  





  

  





 In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
   

  





  

  





 In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:
   

  

 As part of the Security Intelligence team, you will be assessing and reducing threats to Eurofins.
   

  

 You will be responsible for tracking targeted campaigns and threat actors, analyzing intrusions, utilizing data gathered through incident response, discovering our threat surface, and analyzing and translating threats to Eurofins’ infrastructure and leveraging intelligence to improve the security posture.
   

  

  

  

 POSITION \& OBJECTIVES:
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 • Proactively identify and track targeted intrusion cyber threats, trends and new developments by adversaries throughout multiple regions by analysis of raw intelligence and data.
   

  

 • Conduct thorough analysis of threat data from various sources, including open\-source intelligence (OSINT), dark web monitoring and proprietary threat feeds.
   

  

 • Apply analytic best practices and tradecraft to gathered intelligence in a consistent manner.
   

  

 • Provide finished intelligence analysis assessments to internal stakeholders through written reporting with minimal supervision.
   

  

 • Identify intelligence gaps and submit requests for information to fill gaps.
   

  

 • Provide peer review of proposed/draft reporting and analytic uplift to team members.
   

  

 • Prioritize, categorize and respond to requests for information from internal stakeholders.
   

  

 • Assist in the development and enhancement of threat intelligence tools and processes.
   

  

 • Work closely with incident response, threat hunting, vulnerability management and security operations teams to provide intelligence support during security incidents.
   

  

 Technical Knowledge:
   

  

 • Familiarity with Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs) and tools.
   

  

 • Proficiency in analyzing malware and vulnerabilities.
   

  

 • Knowledge in any of scripting languages like Python, Bash Scripts, PowerShell (Nice to have).
   

  

 • Hands\-on Experience with setup, configuration, integration of MISP and leveraging the tool to enhance Security Intelligence in Eurofins with different playbooks created in SOAR platform.
   

  

 • Understanding of technical terminology, tools and tactics employed by threat actors.
   

  

 • Ability or willingness to learn to conduct technical analysis of the tools and tradecraft used by threat actors.
   

  

 • Good knowledge of MITRE ATT\&ck framework and known APT groups activity
   

  

 Personal Qualities:
   

  

 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (concise writing and oral convincing);
   

  

 • Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities.
   

  

 • Excellent interpersonal, analytical, detail\-oriented, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 • Proactive personality who can adapt to changing priorities and a keen analytical mindset to investigate cases.
   

  

 • Good team player with ability to work with team spread across the world.
   

  

  

  

 What we offer:
   

  

 • Opportunity to grow in a demanding, fast\-growing organization.
   

  

 • Very attractive, multicultural and friendly work environment in fast\-growing international company (more than 65 000 employees now)
   

  

 • Possibility to grow and make the next step in your professional career and self\-development.
   

  

 • A launch pad into various opportunities – within many business lines of Eurofins globally
   

  

 • A chance to become part of a highly motivated international team of professionals.
   

  

  

  

  

  

 QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
   

  

 • BE/B.Tech/MCA or any other equivalent degree.
   

  

 • 2\+ years’ experience in Security / Threat Intelligence role.
   

  

 • 5 years of incremental experience in the areas of Cybersecurity.

description:
**Experience:** 1–2 years post\-graduation (freshers with strong prior internship/project experience also considered)

**About the Role**

QLB Marketing Insights and TechNavik Solutions run integrated, multi\-channel Go\-To\-Market programs for B2B technology companies spanning global account\-based webinars, industry\-specific podcast series, joint marketing plans with global technology platform partners, and curated closed\-door executive roundtables. Each program runs across email, social, thought leadership content, nurture sequences, live events, and small\-group CXO engagements simultaneously, and the value we deliver depends on how tightly these pieces are held together, not on how well any single one is executed in isolation.

We are looking for a GTM Orchestration \& AI Manager to own that connective layer: someone who can take a campaign brief and build the full architecture behind it — who gets touched, in what sequence, through which channel, building toward what event or conversation and then keep every moving part in sync as the program runs. AI and automation tools are part of how the work gets done faster; they are not the job itself. The job is the orchestration.

**What You Will Own**

* End\-to\-end design of multi\-channel GTM campaigns mapping how email, LinkedIn/social, thought leadership content, nurture tracks, podcasts, and events connect into a single sequenced pipeline rather than disconnected activities.
* Global account\-based webinar programs from target account selection through to promotion, speaker coordination, and post\-event nurture.
* Industry\-vertical podcast series designed to build thought leadership and influence specific buyer communities over time.
* Joint marketing plans built alongside global technology platform partners translating a partnership into a structured go\-to\-market motion for a defined market or industry.
* Small\-group, closed\-door executive roundtables and meetups owning the intelligence, invitation strategy, and follow\-through that make these events convert into pipeline.
* Positioning campaigns that establish partner or client organizations as thought leaders within specific technology architectures or industry niches.
* A single, coherent pipeline view across all mediums ensuring signals and engagement from every channel roll up into one account\-level picture rather than sitting in silos.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and sequence full\-funnel GTM campaigns that combine outbound, content, events, and nurture into one orchestrated program per account or account cluster.
* Build and manage Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) programs against target account lists built from market signals and intent data.
* Use AI tools for research, content generation, personalization, and sales enablement as an accelerant within the broader campaign, not a standalone deliverable.
* Build automation across CRM, email, and campaign tools using APIs and no\-code/low\-code platforms so the pipeline stays connected without manual handoffs.
* Track market signals funding, hiring, partnerships, acquisitions, product launches and translate them into timely, relevant outreach.
* Coordinate cross\-functional execution across research, content, sales, and leadership so campaign elements land in the right order.
* Build dashboards and reporting that show how each channel is contributing to a single pipeline, not just channel\-level activity metrics.
* Support enterprise and CXO engagement programs, including closed\-door events, from planning through post\-event follow\-up.

**Who This Role Is For**

Someone who can hold complexity who sees a campaign brief and instinctively thinks in systems and sequences rather than tasks. You should be comfortable being the person who notices when a piece of a campaign is about to fall out of sync with the rest, and who fixes that before it becomes visible to the client.

**Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in GTM, demand generation, marketing operations, sales operations, or a closely related field; strong recent graduates with substantial internship or project experience will also be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and connect multi\-step, multi\-channel initiatives not just execute individual tasks.
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM.
* Comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar) for research, content, and personalization.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, or Power Automate, and a basic understanding of how APIs connect systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the judgment to manage stakeholders across client, partner, and internal teams.
* Sharp analytical thinking able to read a campaign's performance across channels and know what to adjust.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Python or JavaScript.
* Exposure to Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) frameworks.
* Prior experience with SaaS, IT services, or technology companies.
* Experience supporting or coordinating live events, webinars, or executive roundtables.

**Why Join Us**

* Ownership of complex, high\-visibility GTM programs from day one, working directly with leadership.
* Exposure to global account\-based marketing, technology\-partner co\-marketing, and executive\-level engagement programs.
* A role defined by orchestration and judgment, not task execution high ownership with real strategic impact.

title: GUI / Computer-Use Video Data Annotator
description:
**About the Company**

Skyfall is disrupting the entire AI ecosystem by building the first world model for the enterprise. The goal of the ‘Enterprise World Model’ is to overcome the severe limitations of LLMs (Safety, Hallucinations, Expensive training) in order to provide enterprises significant value by having a comprehensive understanding of the complex interplay between data, people, and processes within organizations.

The Skyfall founding team consists of Maluuba founders who were previously pioneers in the Deep Learning revolution. Maluuba worked with AI pioneers such as Yoshua Bengio and Richard Sutton before it was acquired by Microsoft for $160M and became Microsoft’s AI research center in Canada.

**About the Role**

You will help build the training dataset that teaches our world model how humans use software. Our models learn to understand and predict computer\-use workflows from real screen recordings, and the quality of that learning is entirely dependent on the quality of the data you curate.

Working alongside the world modeling team, you will review large volumes of computer\-use videos, verify AI\-proposed labels, separate genuine task workflows from non\-workflow content, and flag noise and edge cases. This is precise, high\-volume, judgment\-driven work: every label you produce becomes ground truth the model trusts. A small, careless error can compound through training into a real failure in the deployed agent so accuracy, consistency, and integrity matter far more than raw speed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Verify AI\-proposed taxonomy labels (Domain, Subdomain, Software) on sampled videos, marking each as correct or incorrect against the labeling guide.
* Review video clips to determine whether they show genuine computer\-use workflows (step\-by\-step task completion) versus non\-workflow content (talking\-head commentary, passive browsing, discussion), following defined labeling criteria.
* Annotate visual noise in sampled video frames (zoom, overlays, cursor effects, callouts, transitions, etc.), applying one or more labels per frame per guidelines.
* Work through shared, trackable annotation buckets across datasets ranging from 1,000–5,000\+ videos.
* Flag ambiguous cases, edge cases, or tooling issues to the team rather than guessing, leaving clear notes to support escalation.
* Maintain consistent accuracy and pace against team\-set quality and throughput targets, adapting quickly as guidelines evolve.
* Surface gaps or ambiguities in the labeling guidelines and taxonomy so they can be refined over time.

**Core Requirements (Must\-Haves)**

**Attention to Detail, Judgment \& Integrity**

* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to stay consistent across long, repetitive, high\-volume work.
* Ability to follow detailed, evolving labeling guidelines precisely and apply them uniformly.
* Sound judgment to distinguish genuine workflows from non\-workflow content and to recognize edge cases.
* High integrity: prioritizes accuracy over throughput, and escalates ambiguity rather than guessing or forcing a label.

**Software \& Technical Fluency**

* Strong general computer literacy and comfort navigating desktop operating systems (Windows, macOS, or Linux), web browsers, and common productivity, creative, and developer software, enough to intuitively recognize what a real task workflow looks like.
* Comfortable working with web\-based annotation tools, spreadsheets, and trackers.
* Clear written English to document flags, notes, and edge cases unambiguously.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Computer Science, IT, or Engineering is a plus).
* 0–3 years in data annotation, QA / manual software testing, IT operations, or a similarly detail\-oriented, guideline\-driven role. Strong freshers with clear aptitude will be considered.
* Available to work full\-time on\-site at HSR Layout, Bengaluru for the duration of the 3\-month contract.

**Preferred (nice to have):**

* Prior experience in AI data operations, video/content auditing, e\-commerce/retail operations, or medical coding i.e., backgrounds that reward diligence under repetition.
* Basic understanding of how AI/ML models learn from training data.

 Paperflite is a fast\-growing SaaS company headquartered in the US with operations in Chennai, providing a next\-generation content management platform for sales and marketing teams. We were also recognized as one of America’s best startup employers by Forbes in 2023 and 2024 as well.
 



  





**Role overview:** 




 As our Associate Product Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the narrative of our product journey. Think of yourself as the strategic architect, working on features that captivate our users and push the boundaries of B2B SaaS excellence.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office ( 5 days )
 



  





**Here's what you'll be doing:** 



* Prioritise and manage sprint backlogs to ensure efficient and successful product delivery.
* Organise and lead Sprint planning workshops, retrospectives, and demo sessions. Conduct stand\-ups, publish Sprint burn\-down charts, and collaborate with teams to address blocks and dependencies.
* Define comprehensive product feature sets, facilitating backlog grooming sessions, and crafting clear requirements for user stories.
* Break down feature sets into quantifiable and measurable user stories for seamless implementation by design, engineering, and testing teams.
* Analyse competitor products for feature parity and capability comparisons, staying ahead in the product landscape.
* Define and document acceptance criteria for feature sets to maintain clarity and quality in product delivery.
* Monitor feature usage and user behaviour to enhance product and feature adoption.
* Translate overarching product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes.
* Scope and prioritise activities based on their business and customer impact, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Collaborate seamlessly across disciplines, including Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Development, and Data Science teams, fostering a cohesive working environment.
* Effectively manage product build timelines, priorities, and dependencies across agile teams, ensuring a synchronized and streamlined development process.



  





**What you’ll need to join the team:** 



* 1 \- 3 years of total software product management experience of which a minimum of 2\+ yrs working in the B2B SaaS space.

* Proven expertise in leading scrum teams, ensuring defect\-free, on\-time feature roll\-outs that elevate product performance.

* Familiarity with the Sales and Marketing tech stack, including CRM platforms, Marketing automation tools, Email automation products, content creation tools, and more.
* In\-depth knowledge of marketing and sales lifecycles, along with an understanding of different roles and responsibilities throughout the life cycle.
* A passion for delivering customer value, exemplified by a track record of building robust customer relationships.
* Demonstrate the ability to engage deeply with customers on technical product topics in 1:1 interactions.



  





**The Paperflite Difference:** 



* Work and learn from a talented team that is building an industry\-first solution.
* No rigid hierarchy, with a friendly environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

* If you’re a furball fanatic, then you’re in luck: we’ve got four dogs and a cat who will shower you with love and lick you to infinite glory.

description:

description:
Job Title: HR Management Intern (High\-Exposure / Multi\-Industry)

About Us

Keystone Collective is not your traditional corporate HR department. We are a dynamic HR outsourcing firm, which means we act as the strategic HR engine for a diverse portfolio of companies across completely different industry segments. For a budding HR professional, this means you don't just learn how one company works—you learn how the entire business ecosystem operates.

The Reality Check

**If you think HR is just an "easy, people\-oriented job" with standard 9\-to\-5 routines, this role is not for you.**

We are looking for a sharp, high\-energy, and genuinely passionate individual. You will be tossed into the deep end of end\-to\-end HR operations across multiple sectors simultaneously. The learning curve is steep, the pace is fast, but the professional exposure is unmatched.

Key Responsibilities

You won't be stuck doing coffee runs or just filing papers. You will actively manage and execute end\-to\-end HR activities, including:

* **Multi\-Industry Recruitment:** Sourcing, screening, and onboarding talent for completely different sectors, adapting your strategy to each industry's unique demands.
* **Operations \& Compliance:** Assisting with payroll inputs, employee documentation, and ensuring compliance across various client frameworks.
* **Client Coordination:** Acting as a bridge between Keystone Collective and our client partners to understand and execute their specific HR needs.
* **Employee Engagement \& Relations:** Designing and implementing engagement initiatives tailored to diverse organizational cultures.

Who You Are

* **Genuinely Passionate:** You see HR as a core business driver, not a soft administrative function.
* **Intellectually Sharp:** You can jump from an IT client's requirements to a manufacturing client's needs without missing a beat.
* **Resilient \& Adaptive:** You thrive under pressure and view ambiguity as an opportunity to figure things out.
* **Excellent Communicator:** You possess top\-tier verbal and written communication skills to interface confidently with various stakeholders.

What’s in It for You?

* **Exponential Growth:** Gain 1–2 years worth of diverse organizational experience packed into a single internship.
* **True End\-to\-End Exposure:** Master everything from recruitment to offboarding across multiple industries.
* **Mentorship:** Work directly under industry experts who will push you to your highest potential.
* **Certificate \& Letter of Recommendation** (with potential for a full\-time role based on stellar performance).

Pay: From ₹5,000\.00 per month

title: IN_Senior Manager_Employee Relation_Human Capital_IFS_Mumbai
description:
**Job Profile** 
**:** 
 At PwC, our people in people strategy focus on developing and implementing long\-term strategies to align the organisation's human capital with its overall business objectives. This involves analysing workforce trends, applying the latest HR strategy, long\-term workforce planning and improving overall employee experience. In business partnering at PwC, you will focus on strategic consulting with business stakeholders, advising on people strategies, policies and programmes to achieve current and future business objectives and overcome people related challenges. You will work collaboratively with the wider HR team to shape the Firm’s people strategy and priorities based on their understanding of the business as well as influence the business alignment with and adoption of firmwide direction.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Manager – Employee Relations will act as a strategic partner to the business and HR leadership, responsible for managing complex employee relations matters, conducting investigations, advising leadership on people risk, and ensuring compliance with employment laws and organizational policies.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in maintaining a fair, compliant, and high\-trust workplace by managing high\-risk ER cases, advising senior leaders, strengthening ER governance frameworks, and driving proactive employee relations initiatives across the organization.

* Support the design and implementation of ER governance frameworks, processes, and policies across the organization.

* Provide ER support during large\-scale workforce actions or sensitive business changes.

* Educate stakeholders on ER processes, investigation protocols, and employment law updates.

* Analyze ER case trends and employee issues to identify systemic risks.

title: Associate / Sr Associate - HR and Business Management
description:
**About Axience:** 




**Introduction:** 



* Axience is a professional business services firm, established with the credo of delivering “Integrated Bespoke Solutions” for our clients
* We provide high\-quality bespoke and boutique\-style financial and business research services and have established ourselves as a well\-regarded research firm with a strong clientele, board, and management team
* Our offices are located in Mumbai, India and the UAE, with extended sales and execution capabilities
* At Axience, we carefully hire at the fresher and experienced levels and develop our team even more carefully
* Hiring and Personnel development are both continuous, ongoing processes and so we are looking for a Human Resources Manager who will oversee both in a structured manner
* We offer competitive financial rewards, rapid learning and growth, and significant and varied responsibility to exceptionally driven and motivated candidates. We provide an intellectually stimulating and empowering work environment and place a high emphasis on being an equal opportunity employer



  





**The Role:** 




**Associate / Sr Associate \- HR and Business Management** 




**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





**Human Resources Policy Development and Implementation** 



* Review, challenge and redesign all human resources and related policies/guidelines/documents – both existing and absent ones
* Update policies based on each instance/event/question in a professional manner and communicate
* Maintain world\-class standards while doing so



  





**Employee Development and Employer Branding** 



* Implement management vision by driving and implementing a world\-class (yet suitable to the firm and instance) first call to offer recruitment cycle
* Conduct HR meetings with employees on a regular basis and draw inferences for the long\-term development of staff
* Maintain per employee trackers to measure their performance, career development plan and associated appraisals and training/ upgradation schedules



  





**Recruitment** 



* Conduct high\-energy, research\-driven recruitment based on competition/market/industry knowledge and define/implement exceptional processes
* Ability to run targeted time\-bound recruitment drives to fill specific positions and fresh graduate (batch\-based recruitment)
* Ability to represent the organisation in talks at Universities and in outreach with educational institutes
* Data\-driven and process\-driven approach emphasising testing, background verification and band\-based compensation benchmarking



  





**Employee Suggestions and Grievances** 



* Handle all employee grievances and suggestions with a 360\-degree view and with long\-term policy design and its impact in mind



  





**Employer Branding** 



* Initiate policies, processes, actions, and events to increase the popularity of the brand
* Create successful ex\-employee case studies
* Liaise with team leaders and managers, introduce specific HR initiatives and recommend HR solutions aligned to business objectives and strategy
* Improve organisational design and structure, support change leadership and management coaching
* Be responsible for Talent Management, Performance Management, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Staffing, Succession Planning, Organisation Structure, and Skills Assessments



  





**﻿Administration and Business Management** 



* Optional responsibilities based on the profile of the candidate; ie a senior\-level HR professional with desirous of having business management responsibility would have significant business/office/administration management responsibilities



  





**Academic and professional background:** 



* Master / Graduates from top\-tier institutions and degrees renowned in HR/Administration for
* Strong academic background and aptitude with consistent performance at all levels/, record of extra\-curricular achievements
* Experience from tier 1 companies and institutions
* SHRM and other certifications are desired



  
 



**Required skills:** 



* Ability to think like a manager/business mind and not simply like a recruiter/HR process executor
* Exceptional personality combining an aura and humility
* General exposure and wisdom



  





**Contact** 




 If you have the qualification, experience, and passion for the role mentioned above, please send your CV and Cover Letter to hr.openings@axience.com.
 



  





**Other Requirements** 



* Only Mumbai based candidates or those who are willing to relocate to Mumbai will be considered
* Willing to work from the office 5 days a week. The office location is Andheri East, Mumbai
* Strong Academic grades and International travel experience are preferred

 The role will act as a trusted partner to business leaders while ensuring seamless execution of end\-to\-end HR processes and fostering a high\-performance culture. Will be responsible for driving people initiatives that enable business growth, employee engagement, talent development, and HR process excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for regional sales, marketing, and support functions.
* Ensure quality hiring within defined turnaround time.
* Coordinate interviews, salary negotiations, documentation, and onboarding.
* Ensure smooth induction and assimilation of new employees.
* Monitor new hire productivity and probation confirmation.



**2\. HR Business Partnering** 



* Partner closely with the Regional Business Head and functional managers to understand business priorities and translate them into HR interventions.
* Drive people strategies aligned with regional sales and business objectives.
* Act as the first point of contact for all employee\-related matters.



**3\. Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Execute employee engagement initiatives.
* Organize learning sessions, recognition programs, celebrations, and wellness initiatives.
* Conduct employee connect meetings.
* Improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
* Drive employer branding initiatives within the region.

* Handle employee grievances in a fair and timely manner.

* Ensure adherence to company policies and code of conduct.
* Promote a positive and collaborative work environment.

* Maintain employee records and HRIS accuracy.
* Coordinate with payroll and compliance teams for employee\-related data.
* Ensure timely closure of HR queries.

* Ensure implementation of HR policies across the region.
* Educate employees on HR policies and processes.



**7\. HR Analytics \& MIS** 



* Prepare monthly HR dashboards for the region.

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a recognized institute.

**Work Experience**

* Experience partnering with sales teams.
* Strong knowledge of the employee lifecycle.
* Proficiency in HRMS and Microsoft Excel/Power BI.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to travel within the region as required.

 BPE INNOVATIONS Private Limited is a growing organization based in Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. BPE INNOVATIONS focuses on delivering innovative solutions and services that support business growth and operational efficiency. The role involves developing and implementing HR policies, assisting with performance management processes, and supporting compliance with labor laws and company guidelines. * Candidates should possess experience in Employee Benefits administration and related documentation.
* Candidates should possess effective Personnel Management skills, including employee relations and conflict resolution.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with diverse teams.

* Prior experience in an HR generalist or specialist role, preferably in an on\-site setting, will be beneficial.

**Job Description**

**Position: MIS Executive**

**Department:** IT / MIS  
**Industry:** Building Material (Ceramic \& Bathware)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Location:** Agra, Uttar Pradesh  
**Salary:** ₹22,000 – ₹28,000 per month

**About Ishan Ceramic Pvt. Ltd. (ICPL)**

Ishan Ceramic Pvt. Ltd. (ICPL) was established with the vision of delivering world\-class ceramic solutions backed by over two decades of industry expertise. Today, we have a strong presence across Western Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, South India, and international markets including the Middle East, Sri Lanka, and Europe.

Driven by cutting\-edge manufacturing technology and continuous innovation, our in\-house R\&D team is committed to delivering premium\-quality ceramic products that exceed customer expectations.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail\-oriented **MIS Executive** to manage business data, prepare insightful reports, develop dashboards, and support management with data\-driven decision\-making. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, advanced Excel expertise, and experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

**MIS Reporting \& Data Analysis**

* Prepare Daily, Weekly, Monthly \& Quarterly MIS reports.
* Design and maintain interactive dashboards for Sales, Finance, Inventory, HR, Purchase, and Operations.
* Analyze sales trends, customer performance, inventory movement, and business KPIs.
* Generate reports for management reviews and strategic planning.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely report submission.

**Dashboard Development \& Business Intelligence**

* Develop interactive dashboards using **Power BI** and **Looker Studio**.
* Create data visualizations and performance reports.
* Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency.
* Monitor KPIs and present actionable business insights.

**Database \& Data Management**

* Manage and maintain large datasets.
* Perform data cleaning, validation, and reconciliation.
* Maintain master data and ensure database accuracy.
* Coordinate with various departments to collect business data.

**Automation \& Process Improvement**

* Automate MIS reports using Excel formulas, Power Query, and Macros.
* Improve reporting processes to reduce manual effort.
* Document MIS processes and SOPs.
* Support ERP reporting and system improvements.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Sales, Accounts, HR, Purchase, Warehouse, and Management teams.
* Understand reporting requirements and deliver customized MIS reports.
* Provide analytical support for business planning and decision\-making.

**Required SkillsTechnical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, Dashboards, Advanced Formulas, Charts)
* Power BI
* Looker Studio
* Google Sheets
* Google Analytics (GA4\)
* SQL (Basic to Intermediate)
* Microsoft Power Query
* Microsoft Power Pivot
* VBA \& Excel Macros (Preferred)
* ERP Systems (Odoo ERP preferred)
* CRM Reporting
* Data Visualization Tools
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Data Cleaning \& Validation Techniques

**Analytical Skills**

* Strong analytical and logical thinking
* Excellent numerical aptitude
* Data interpretation and reporting
* Problem\-solving ability
* High attention to detail

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication skills
* Time management
* Team collaboration
* Ability to work under pressure
* Strong organizational skills

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, BCA, B.Sc. (Computer Science), B.Com, BBA, or any relevant discipline.
* Certification in Power BI, Advanced Excel, Data Analytics, or Business Intelligence will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience as an MIS Executive, Data Analyst, MIS Analyst, Reporting Executive, or Business Analyst.
* Freshers with exceptional skills in Advanced Excel and Power BI may also apply.

title: Junior Equity Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Junior Equity Analyst** 

**Job Purpose:**

Are you passionate about the stock market and eager to dive into the world of equity analysis? Join our dynamic team as a Junior Equity Analyst and embark on a journey of hands\-on training and growth within the exciting realm of global market trading. You will gain invaluable experience analyzing the US markets, learning the intricacies of stock trading, and preparing yourself to make informed, data\-driven trading decisions that could shape your career.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Master Technical Analysis**: Learn how to perform cutting\-edge technical analysis on major US stock exchanges including NYSE, NASDAQ, and Amex, unlocking the power to predict market movements.
* **Evaluate Securities:** Gain expertise in assessing the performance and pricing of US listed companies, using advanced tools and techniques to uncover trends and opportunities.
* **Forecast Market Trends:** Develop your skills in forecasting stock performance and creating actionable projections based on thorough research and analysis.
* **Stay Ahead of the Curve:** Keep a close eye on industry trends, market news, and global events that impact stock prices and market behavior.
* **Create Impactful Reports:** Hone your ability to craft well\-informed, data\-backed reports that evaluate company fundamentals, historical performance, and potential future outcomes.
* **Career Growth**: Upon successful completion of the program, transition into a full fledged US Equity Analyst/Trader, where you’ll make key decisions in the US stock market, influencing the organization’s trading strategy.

**Qualifications:** 

* **Educational Background:** A degree in Finance (e.g., B. Com, BBA, MBA, PGDM) or certifications such as NCFM, CFA, or CMT. Passion for finance and trading is a must!
* **Age Range:** Open to individuals between 20\-24 years of age, ready to kick\-start their career in equity analysis.
* **Fresh Mindset:** Open to freshers or those looking to pivot into the world of stock market analysis and trading.
* **Not a Recent Applicant:** Candidates who have participated in the selection process within the last 6 months are not eligible.

**Work Timings \& Location:**

* **Work Hours:** 06:00 PM to 03:00 AM, Monday to Friday—ideal for those who enjoy aligning their workday with global financial markets and US trading hours.
* **Location: Eon IT Park, Kharadi, Pune.** Work in a modern, vibrant environment that fosters growth and innovation.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Skill Development:** Receive comprehensive, hands\-on training with the potential to grow into a high\-impact **US Equity Analyst role.**
* **Career Advancement:** This position provides clear career progression with exciting opportunities for professional growth. After training, top performers will have the opportunity to advance to roles such as:

**1\. Associate US Equity Analyst** 

**2\. Equity Analyst** 

**3\. Senior Equity Analyst**

* **Incentives \& Rewards:** Enjoy a highly attractive incentive program, rewarding your hard work and achievements.
* **No Sales or Marketing:** This is a purely analytical role—no selling or marketing of financial products or services. Focus on what matters most: analyzing markets and making data\-driven decisions.

**Training Program:** 

* **Duration:** Minimum 3\-month training period (subject to progress).
* **Full\-Time, Permanent:** This is a full\-time opportunity with long\-term potential.

**Interview Process:**

**1\. HR Round:** We want to know about your background, motivations, and passion for financial markets.

**2\. Aptitude Test:** Showcase your quantitative skills and ability to analyze complex data.

**3\. Technical/Manager’s Round:** Dive deep into your knowledge of market analysis and your ability to interpret financial data and trends.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: From ₹2,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Stock market: 1 year (Required)

title: AI Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Cybersecurity Analyst based in India.**
 This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity operations and AI\-driven security automation, where human expertise is essential to validate and refine machine\-generated threat insights. You will work within a modern SOC environment powered by advanced XDR and SIEM technologies, ensuring that automated investigations are accurate, complete, and contextually relevant. The position focuses on bridging AI\-driven detection systems with real\-world security judgment to improve threat response quality. You will analyze incidents, validate findings, and ensure that security workflows execute correctly across complex digital environments. Working in a fast\-evolving cybersecurity landscape, you will contribute directly to improving detection accuracy, reducing false positives, and strengthening operational resilience. This is a highly analytical role where precision, critical thinking, and security expertise directly enhance enterprise threat defense.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Validate AI\-driven SecOps investigations by reviewing incident attack narratives, alerts, entities, and correlated security signals for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure automated investigation workflows execute correctly, identifying and reporting technical issues or inconsistencies in SOC processes.
* Confirm incident verdicts by analyzing and identifying false positives, misclassifications, or incomplete threat assessments.
* Perform deeper technical analysis when required, including file inspection, sandboxing, URL detonation, and contextual investigation using enterprise data sources.
* Review and validate incident management tags and approve, modify, or reject AI\-generated findings before escalation or response actions.
* Collaborate with security teams to refine detection logic and improve the reliability of AI\-assisted security operations.
* Support continuous improvement of Microsoft Defender XDR and Sentinel\-based detection and response workflows.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and operational consistency across security investigations.


**Requirements**
* Strong foundational knowledge of cybersecurity operations, incident response, and threat analysis.
* Familiarity with SIEM and XDR platforms, preferably Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework and common attack techniques and threat behaviors.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated security findings.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies in complex security data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting and explaining incident analysis.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced SOC environments and handle multiple concurrent investigations.
* Relevant certification such as Microsoft SC\-200 is highly desirable.
* Basic understanding of security automation, SOAR concepts, or AI\-assisted SOC workflows is a plus.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging cybersecurity and AI technologies.


**Benefits**
* Competitive base salary with performance\-based biannual bonuses.
* Monthly allowances for health insurance, laptop usage, and internet support.
* Paid time off including up to 20 days annually plus all statutory holidays.
* Opportunities for international assignments across global locations including the USA and UAE.
* Continuous training on advanced cybersecurity tools, AI\-driven SOC technologies, and industry frameworks.
* Certification reimbursement for relevant cybersecurity qualifications and professional development.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI \+ XDR security operations in a high\-growth environment.

title: SALES TRAINEE - IT
description:
**Job post summary**

Job Description:

IT Sales trainee

IT sales consultants are sales professionals who specialize in selling computer hardware and software, as well as IT services. Success in this industry requires advanced knowledge of fundamental IT principles. IT sales professionals have to be able to answer highly technical questions in order to close sales. As the job title suggests, IT sales professionals are employed by companies within the IT industry. This includes companies that sell hardware, such as en user computing devices, servers, storage, networking and other products related to IT infra. It also includes selling software, which can be specific to an industry, such as healthcare or finance, ERP or cloud.

As an IT sales professional, you'll usually work with commercial clients, finding the right technological hardware and software products to suit their business needs.

The work of an IT sales professional falls into three main areas:

* pre\-sales \- giving detailed information about technical specifications and the ways in which they could meet a customer's needs
* sales \- negotiating a commercial agreement to the benefit of both the customer and supplier
* post\-sales (or after\-sales) \- generate inquiries for AMCs, support services etc

Responsibilities as an IT sales professional, you'll need to:

* speak to customers, either face to face or over the phone
* gain an understanding of customers' diverse and specific business needs and apply product knowledge to meet them
* ensure quality of service by developing a thorough and detailed knowledge of technical specifications and other features of employers' systems and processes, and then documenting them
* carry out cold\-calling in order to create interest in products and services, generate new business leads and arrange meetings
* identify and develop new business through networking and follow\-up courtesy calls
* prepare and deliver presentations and demonstrations of software to customers
* market and promote a portfolio of products by writing and designing sales literature and attending industry events
* maintain awareness and keep abreast of constantly changing software and hardware systems and peripherals (e.g. keyboard and mouse)
* develop effective sales plans using sales methodology
* provide technical advice to customers on all aspects of the installation and use of computer systems and networks, both before and after the sale
* advise on software features and how they can be applied to assist in a variety of contexts such as accounting, manufacturing or other specialist areas
* network with existing customers in order to maintain links and promote additional products and upgrades
* handle hardware or software problems and faults, referring on to specialist technical colleagues where appropriate
* respond to tender documents, proposals, reports and supporting literature
* manage workload in order to organise and prioritise daily and weekly goals
* contribute to team or progress meetings to update and inform colleagues.

title: Assistant Manager – Product Marketing
description:
**Role Summary**

The Assistant Manager – Product Marketing is a field\-based leadership role responsible for driving the brand presence of Sreedhareeyam Ayurveda and Farmherbs Botanicals across retail outlets throughout Kerala. The incumbent will be the brand's on\-ground ambassador, ensuring that the company's 100% herbal, plant\-based beauty and baby care products are consistently and compellingly presented at every retail touchpoint. This role suits someone who is proactive, highly mobile, relationship\-driven, and passionate about building a category\-defining herbal brand at the retail level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Retail Brand Presentation \& Display Management**

* Plan, execute, and maintain product displays and planograms across all assigned retail stores in Kerala as per brand standards.
* Ensure prominent shelf placement, correct product sequencing, and maximum share of shelf for brand SKUs.
* Set up and maintain point\-of\-sale (POS) materials including shelf talkers, standees, posters, wobblers, and branded display units.
* Conduct regular store visits to audit display quality, stock levels, pricing accuracy, and brand visibility.
* Identify and capture opportunities for additional display space, secondary placements, and special feature areas within stores.

**2\. Retail Store Coverage \& Field Operations**

* Travel across Kerala to manage and service a defined network of retail accounts including pharmacies, health \& beauty stores, supermarkets, and general trade outlets.
* Plan and execute an efficient beat plan to ensure all assigned stores are visited at the appropriate frequency.
* Build and maintain strong on\-ground relationships with store managers, pharmacists, category buyers, and front\-line retail staff.
* Address and resolve in\-store issues including out\-of\-stocks, expiry concerns, damaged units, and incorrect pricing promptly.

**3\. Product Launch \& Campaign Execution**

* Lead in\-store execution of new product launches across retail channels.
* Implement marketing campaigns, seasonal promotions, and festive display activations aligned with brand guidelines.
* Coordinate availability and placement of launch assets, samples, and promotional materials in advance of campaign dates.
* Monitor the effectiveness of in\-store activations and report results with photographic documentation.

**4\. Stock \& Trade Management**

* Monitor stock levels across stores to prevent out\-of\-stock situations and ensure listing of all active SKUs.
* Coordinate with the sales and distribution team for timely replenishment and order fulfilment at the retail level.
* Track expiry dates and manage first\-in\-first\-out (FIFO) stock rotation at store level.
* Identify and report slow\-moving SKUs and work with the team on corrective action plans.

**5\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor activity at the shelf — pricing, promotions, new launches, and display strategies — and report insights to the marketing team.
* Track market trends, consumer behaviour at retail, and emerging opportunities within the herbal beauty and baby care category.
* Identify gaps in distribution and provide actionable intelligence to support expansion into new retail accounts.

**6\. Retail Staff Training \& Engagement**

* Conduct product education sessions and shelf\-level training for store staff, pharmacists, and sales attendants to improve product knowledge and recommendation rates.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key in\-store influencers who actively recommend products to customers.
* Support in\-store consumer engagement initiatives and product sampling activations.

**7\. Reporting \& Analytics**

* Maintain detailed records of store visits, merchandising status, stock data, and competitive observations.
* Submit structured field visit reports, weekly coverage summaries, and monthly performance reports.
* Maintain a photographic log of in\-store displays before and after merchandising interventions.
* Contribute to monthly retail performance reviews with data\-backed insights and recommendations.

**8\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with the Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to align field execution with brand and business priorities.
* Provide timely feedback from the retail floor to inform product, packaging, and marketing decisions.
* Ensure all promotional assets, POS materials, and product samples are available in sufficient quantity before planned activations.

**Tools \& Platforms**

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel – store visit trackers, beat plans, stock reports
* WhatsApp Business / Email – daily communication with stores, distributors, and internal teams
* Canva / Basic Photo Editing – creating quick field collaterals and documentation
* Google Maps / Route Planning Apps – optimising daily travel schedules across Kerala
* Company CRM / Field Sales App (if applicable) – logging visits and reporting

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Retail Management, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 1–4 years of experience in retail merchandising, field sales, or trade marketing, preferably in beauty, healthcare, or wellness categories.
* Prior exposure to the Kerala retail market — pharmacies, baby\& beauty stores, and general trade — is strongly preferred.
* Freshers with a strong academic background and demonstrated passion for retail or brand building may also be considered.

**Skills \& Attributes**

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with store\-level stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and comfortable working independently across field locations.
* Able to communicate effectively in Malayalam to support day\-to\-day work with local store teams; English proficiency is an added advantage.
* Highly organised with the ability to manage a high\-volume store network and multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Good eye for visual merchandising, display aesthetics, and brand presentation quality.
* Genuine interest in herbal, natural, and Ayurvedic wellness products.

**Job Summary:**
 The HR Business Partner – R\&D APAC will serve as the primary strategic HR partner for Clearwater Analytics’ Research \& Development organisation across the Asia\-Pacific region, covering India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the HR Head of India, this is a senior individual contributor role that partners closely with R\&D leadership to shape and execute a comprehensive people agenda that drives organisational effectiveness, talent excellence, and a high\-performance culture across five dynamic markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Strategic HR Partnership**
* Serves as the primary strategic HR advisor to R\&D senior leadership across India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan — translating business priorities into a cohesive people agenda that supports Clearwater’s engineering and technology growth objectives across the region.
* Engages as a thought leader on APAC people strategy, proactively surfacing regional market intelligence, talent trends, and competitive insights to inform R\&D leadership decisions.


**Talent Management \& Workforce Planning**
* Leads talent management processes for the R\&D APAC population including annual talent reviews, succession planning, career development frameworks, and high\-potential identification across all five markets.
* Partners with Talent Acquisition — APAC to define workforce plans, role architecture, and hiring strategies that meet R\&D scaling goals across India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan.
* Advises on grade\-level structures, technical career ladders, and compensation benchmarking frameworks specific to R\&D roles across diverse APAC talent markets.


**Employee Experience \& Engagement**
* Designs and drives employee engagement strategies tailored to the R\&D engineering population across APAC — identifying root causes of attrition and disengagement through structured listening, pulse surveys, and manager feedback channels.
* Champions a culture of inclusion, recognition, and psychological safety within APAC R\&D teams, partnering with managers on effective onboarding, integration, and long\-term retention of critical engineering talent.


**Performance Management \& Employee Relations**
* Guides R\&D managers through performance calibration, feedback frameworks, and improvement planning, while navigating complex employee relations matters with cultural sensitivity and alignment to local employment laws — including India’s Labour Codes and POSH Act, Singapore’s Employment Act, Australia’s Fair Work Act, Hong Kong’s Employment Ordinance, and Japan’s Labour Standards Act.
* Coaches and upskills APAC R\&D managers on people management fundamentals, navigating difficult conversations, and building high\-performing engineering teams.


**Organisational Design \& Change Management**
* Leads and supports organisational design, workforce restructuring, and change management initiatives within R\&D APAC — ensuring business\-driven decisions are executed with care for employee impact and in compliance with local regulations.
* Collaborates with COEs — Compensation, L\&D, Talent Acquisition, and HR Ops — to localise and deploy people programmes that address the specific needs of a fast\-growing, engineering\-first APAC population.


**HR Programme Leadership**
* Designs and delivers one or more high\-impact people initiatives annually — such as an APAC R\&D retention framework, technical career ladder, or manager capability programme — and represents R\&D APAC in global HR projects and working groups.
* Builds and tracks people strategy metrics for R\&D APAC — including headcount trends, attrition, capability gaps, and engagement scores — reporting regularly to the HR Head of India and R\&D leadership with data\-driven insights and recommended actions.


**Required Skills:**
* Strategic business acumen with the ability to connect people decisions to R\&D engineering outcomes and regional business growth.
* Strong consultancy and influencing skills — able to challenge and advise senior technical leaders with confidence across diverse cultural contexts.
* Hands\-on experience navigating employment legislation in two or more APAC markets (India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan).
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms, particularly Workday; strong analytical capabilities with comfort working with HR data, dashboards, and people metrics.
* Skilled in change management, facilitation, and executive communication across time zones and cultures.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills; collaborative with proven relationship\-building ability across geographies and seniority levels.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities; project management proficiency with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; MBA or Master’s in HRM strongly preferred.
* SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or equivalent professional HR certification is an advantage.
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 6–7 years in a dedicated HRBP role supporting Engineering, Product, or Technology functions in a global organisation.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior R\&D or technology leadership in a high\-growth, multi\-geography SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated experience managing employee relations, organisational design, and talent management across multiple APAC jurisdictions; prior exposure to India plus at least one other APAC market (Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, or Japan) strongly preferred.


**Employee Benefits:**

* Competitive salary, benefits, and special allowances in the compensation package.
* Continual learning and development opportunities for career growth.

title: DevOps Engineer 1
description:
**The Company**
**Serving the People Who Serve the People**
 Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
   

  

 Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
   

  

 Want to know more? See more of what we do here .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The DevOps Engineer I is an entry\-level engineering position responsible for supporting automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability across cloud and hosted application environments. This role partners with software engineering, site reliability, and infrastructure teams to support continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, infrastructure automation, and platform operations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate foundational knowledge of DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, and automation and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment. This position is intended for early\-career professionals developing technical capability in infrastructure, CI/CD, cloud platforms, containerization, and operational support, and passionate about driving platform reliability and efficiency by applying AI across CI/CD, observability, incident response, and infrastructure operations. The engineer will also help adopt AI\-assisted operations by using intelligent tooling to improve triage, diagnostics, and repeatability, while contributing to the development and use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools and AIOps practices.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Look Like**
 Support software delivery activities, including build, deployment, release, and environment management processes.
   

  

* Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines used to build, test, and deploy applications.
* Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure in cloud and hosted environments.
* Troubleshoot application, deployment, and infrastructure issues.
* Monitor system health, review logs, and support improvements in reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Support infrastructure automation and infrastructure as code activities using approved tools and standards.
* Collaborate with engineering, support, and operations teams to resolve issues and improve delivery processes.
* Adhere to established security, compliance, and operational standards in all engineering activities.
* Participate in operational support or on\-call activities, as required.


**You Will Love This Job If You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Foundational knowledge of DevOps concepts, including CI/CD, automation, infrastructure support, and system reliability.
* Basic experience with Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, source control, and cloud infrastructure concepts.
* Familiarity with containers, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and troubleshooting fundamentals.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across technical teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, accountability, and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced engineering environment


 AI Expectations
   

  

* Curiosity about applying AI tools responsibly in infrastructure engineering to improve triage, diagnostics, documentation, operational analysis, and day\-to\-day workflow efficiency.
* Interest in developing, extending, and using MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, APIs and associated skills.
* Familiarity with AIOps concepts such as alert correlation, anomaly detection, event enrichment, and assisted root cause analysis in monitoring\- and operations\-heavy environments.
* Initiative in identifying and implementing opportunities to build AI\-driven scripts, automate operational tasks, and improve engineering workflows through practical, hands\-on use of AI technologies.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to using Python (or similar) to build operational tools with guardrails.


 Career Growth and Work Environment
   

  

 This is an entry\-level individual contributor position intended for early\-career engineers developing foundational capability in DevOps and platform engineering. The DevOps Engineer I is expected to perform assigned responsibilities with guidance from senior team members, resolve routine technical issues, and expand scope and proficiency over time.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and may include participation in a rotational on\-call support model. The role may support systems and environments critical to business operations
   

  

 and therefore requires adherence to established operational, security, and compliance standards.
